related_information: Pre-troubleshooting If a failure code is shown, do the troubleshooting for that code first. Monitoring code • F pump pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 01100) • R pump pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 01101) • Travel PPC pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 01882) • LS-EPC Solenoid Current can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 01500)

steps.procedure: 1. Release the pressure that remains in the hydraulic system to do the troubleshooting. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Release Remained Pressure in Hydraulic Circuit”. 2. Examine the control valve body and the travel spool to see if they are not twisted or stuck. (They must move smoothly and not be stuck.) Are they clean? REMARK Be careful that dirt does not enter during recovery work.

steps.procedure: 1. Release the pressure that remains in the hydraulic tank and piping. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Release Remained Pressure in Hydraulic Circuit”. 2. Adjust the relief valve. 3. Do the troubleshooting. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Examine and Adjust Oil Pressure in Work Equipment, Swing, and Travel Circuits”. 4. Is the oil pressure difference between the front and rear ports equal?
